mechanism: row-to-core balance / sparse tail owner alignment
hypothesis: When at least one full row stripe precedes a tail shorter than blockCount, assigning the sparse tail to the logical-block suffix may reduce each active block's row-address gap from its final full-stripe group while preserving one row per active block.
change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, only when fullGroups > 0, tailRows < blockCount, and rowGroupWidth > 1, shift the active one-row tail owners to the logical-block suffix and assign tail rows in increasing owner order. Inactive owners use a zero-row rank. All other cases retain R042 ownership.

scope_check.details: Only sparse tail row ownership changes for low-precision wide rows with at least one complete stripe and rowGroupWidth > 1. Full stripes, row-group widths, chunk sizes, GM load/store sizes, rowOffset = sourceRow * rowWidth, output row stride, arithmetic, UB buffers, and reduction topology are unchanged. Correctness and performance are not inferred from static validation or Build.

ownership_validation.command: inline python3 -c static enumeration (no file): blockCount 1..48, groupWidth 1..8, all tailRows within a stripe, and fullGroups 0, 1, 3
invariants: Every row is assigned exactly once.
Tail chunks form a contiguous partition of the incomplete stripe.
Per-block tail row counts differ by at most one.
The R043 owner shift is limited to fullGroups > 0, tailRows < blockCount, and groupWidth > 1.
